title: Standard twist data on the transported polynomial Proj twist
statement: Let k be a field, d an integer, P=Proj k[x₀,x₁] with the standard grading [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf], Q=P¹_k with its standard charts [def-sc-p1-standard], and C:P≅Q a chart-compatible isomorphism [def-sc-p1-proj-chart-isomorphism]. The ordinary module pullback (C.iso.inv)^* O_P(d), namely the source library left adjoint to module pushforward (equivalently the tensor-formula pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]), admits TwistData of degree d: sections g₀,g₁ on U₀,U₁ freely generating on every subopen, with g₀=t^(-d)g₁ on U₀∩U₁. No other module L, isomorphism to L, or uniqueness assertion occurs.

source.place: Lemma 01M7 (2),(3), applied to the shifted ring; blueprint lem-sc-p1-graded-resolution final clause, local generators and transition equation

proof.text: On each D₊(xᵢ), take the section xᵢ^d of O_P(d). For d ≥ 0 this is the fraction xᵢ^d/1 and for d < 0 it is 1/xᵢ^(-d). The degree-d locally homogeneous fractions are multiplied by xᵢ^(-d) to degree-zero fractions, with inverse multiplication by xᵢ^d. These maps commute with all restrictions. Thus xᵢ^d is a free generator on every subopen. In Lean the existing proved declarations Proj.twistPowSection and Proj.isFreeGenerator_twistPowSection supply this step directly, including negative d.

source.place: Lemma 01M7 (2),(3), applied to the shifted ring; blueprint lem-sc-p1-graded-resolution final clause, local generators and transition equation

proof.text: C.chart_eq identifies the chart D₊(xᵢ) with Uᵢ and its ratio coordinates with those of the glued line. In particular (C.iso.inv)⁻¹(D₊(xᵢ))=Uᵢ. Pull back xᵢ^d along C.iso.inv, using the unit of the ordinary Scheme.Modules pullback adjunction, to obtain gᵢ. The proved source lemma Scheme.Modules.IsFreeGenerator.pullback_unit_app says these sections are free generators on the preimage opens, hence on Uᵢ. Its bijectivity conclusion on every subopen is exactly bijective_smul_g₀ or bijective_smul_g₁. Ordinary pullback is the source library left adjoint to module pushforward; it agrees with the tensor-formula pullback by uniqueness of left adjoints, as explicitly proved in the parent module.

source.place: Lemma 01M7 (2),(3), applied to the shifted ring; blueprint lem-sc-p1-graded-resolution final clause, local generators and transition equation

proof.text: On D₊(x₀)∩D₊(x₁), x₀ and x₁ are units. The identity x₀^d=(x₀/x₁)^d x₁^d follows from multiplication and inversion of units, for every integer d. The chart equations send x₀/x₁ to t⁻¹, so the induced ring map sends its d-th power to transitionUnit(d,0,1). The pullback unit commutes with restriction and scalar multiplication. Applying it to the identity therefore gives map_g₀ for g₀,g₁. Assemble the two sections, the two free-generator conclusions and this equation into TwistData. For d=0 this is 1=1; for d=-1 it is x₀⁻¹=(x₀/x₁)⁻¹x₁⁻¹. No arbitrary module or global comparison is constructed in this step.

theorem nonempty_twistData_pullback_inv (k : Type v) [Field k]
    (d : ℤ) (C : ProjectiveLine.ProjChartIsomorphism k) :

      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.iso.inv).obj
        (twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) d)))
